scope: Read-only installed original kernel personality and superclass inspection while boot19 tests userclient authorization; no input or policy changes.

source.parse_method: XML dictionary with ID/IDREF resolution; no assumed integer values from ID labels.

normal_personality.interpretation: Generic personality includes all Digitizer page13 usages without a vendor/product restriction. Standard TouchScreen application usage4 belongs to this pair; Finger logical collection need not independently match a personality. A separate vendor-specific VMWare personality is irrelevant to owned identity.

superclass.proof: At83363c0..83363dc, constructs metaclass IOHIDEventDriver (gMetaClass0xfffffff0099e6f60) with superclass IOHIDEventService gMetaClass0xfffffff0099e6ec0.
superclass.original_conforms_rpc: is_io_object_conforms_to0xfffffff008093d78 invokes OSMetaClassBase::metaCast(char const*) at8093d90 and returns nonNULL as true at8093d9c..8093da4. This tests ancestry rather than exact IOClass string.
superclass.system_wrapper: Original System IOKit IOObjectConformsTo0x1812d95a0 invokes its RPC path at1812d95d0 and consumes returned Boolean.

expected_topology: Owned IOHIDUserDevice publishes IOHIDInterface; matched generic IOHIDEventDriver is expected beneath that interface. Existing helper recursive IOService iterator searches descendants rather than only immediate children, so it can cover this shape.
limits: Static personality eligibility and ancestry do not establish matching completion, successful parse/start, BackBoard acceptance or touch delivery. IOMatchDefer=true means creation alone is not evidence of event-service registration; preserve bounded readiness wait and record actual classes/IDs. No additional entitlement or property is justified by this inspection.
primary_corroboration: https://github.com/apple-oss-distributions/IOHIDFamily/blob/IOHIDFamily-1446.140.2/IOHIDFamily/IOHIDEventDriver.cpp (OSDefineMetaClassAndStructors(IOHIDEventDriver, IOHIDEventService)); installed original constructor above is authoritative.
